title: Google’s Pixel Watch 5 Pumps Up Its Fitness Smarts
summary: Google says the Pixel Watch 5 is 15 percent more accurate at tracking sleep than its predecessor. The Watch 5 is Google’s best smartwatch , but many of the new software features will also be rolling out to the Watch 4.
